title: Sherman family haunted off the ranch

tellings.quote: in the 90s a family named the shermans took over the ranch and were basically haunted off the property they encountered orbs ufos skin walkers and even got rushed by an oversized bipedal wolf that they claimed was able to withstand a close range attack from a shotgun

plain: In the 1990s, a family named the Shermans took over Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for strange events, and were, as the story goes, haunted off the land. Michels tells this himself in an episode about his own visit to the ranch, saying the family met glowing orbs, UFOs and skinwalkers (shape-shifting creatures from Navajo lore), and were even rushed by an oversized wolf walking on two legs that they said survived a close-range shotgun blast. The story is told as the reason the ranch became famous.
